parsed.post: The last experiment (1.028483) was a regression from my best (1.003677). It appears the attempt to scale batch size and aspect ratio simultaneously caused instability. Reverting to 399b3be. Next, I will increase ASPECT_RATIO to 64 but keep the batch size stable to isolate the effect of context length.
parsed.description: Increasing ASPECT_RATIO to 64 to enhance model capacity/context while keeping TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE constant to avoid the instability seen in the previous run.
